name: Ryoujoku Finder
source:
Main character is a photography director with his clients being mostly idols. At his sessions he strips his clients and makes indecent photos that he later sells. This time he prepares and insulting photo session for two busty cosplay idol sisters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-september-2004-abandoner.html]vndbreview[/url]]
